description: Create a one-time chore on a Skylight frame, either assigned to one family member (`category_id`) or unassigned so anyone can claim it (`up_for_grabs: true`). Pass exactly one of the two. For a repeating up-for-grabs chore use skylight_create_recurring_chore.

category_id.description: Category / family-member id the chore belongs to. Get ids from skylight_list_categories. Omit when up_for_grabs is true.

start.description: YYYY-MM-DD date. Omit for an undated chore.

up_for_grabs.description: Set true for an unassigned "anyone can do it" chore (pass no category_id).

name: skylight_create_chore
